title: bls12-381-fixed-g1-invert-g2: parallel distinguished-point rho in GT

claims.statement: For a uniform nonidentity P in BLS12-381 G1 and an independent uniform z in GT, the attack in proof.md returns Q=[a]Q0 in G2 with e(P,Q)=z under the pinned pairing convention, using at most 2^127.85 total target-group-operation equivalents (dense Fp12 multiplications, C=20,000). It computes g=e(P,Q0) (a generator) and solves z=g^a by a van Oorschot-Wiener parallel distinguished-point Pollard rho on GT: a deterministic R-adding walk F(X)=X*M_H(X) (R=2^20) costs ONE dense Fp12 multiplication per step (no tortoise/hare factor); the partition index H and the DP predicate (theta=2^-64) read bits of the least-significant limb of the first REDUCED TOWER coefficient the reference multiplication outputs (unique per element, no Montgomery/flat export in the walk); table exponents are drawn from the rules' fresh uniform algorithm coins (512 bits reduced mod r, bias<2^-256). DP reports are routed to 2^16 separate storage nodes each addressing <2^64 bytes (<=2^58 bytes/node), with 2^17 instructions charged per report and node set-up 2^20 instructions/node, so no single >2^64-byte address space is assumed; node overflow halts as a counted failure (Chernoff). The hard budget is T=ceil(1.3*k0) total multiplications (k0=sqrt(2*r*ln(1/0.61))); a collision exists within T with probability 1-0.61^1.69=0.548, detection lag after a merge is <=1/theta=2^64 (negligible), and reserving a 0.10 production-transfer margin gives a supported success lower bound >=0.448>=0.39. Each multiplication is <=1.014 units; W=1.3*k0*1.014=2^127.819 plus negligible report/one-time work, rounded to 2^127.85. Peak memory is <=2^74 bytes distributed over 2^16 native nodes (reported only; access charged). Preprocessing <=2^31 units included; nonuniform advice 0 bytes. Classical cold attack, no uncharged advice or quantum steps; generic square-root accounting, not a practical break.

experiments.purpose: Run parallel distinguished-point Pollard rho on a prime-order-l subgroup of F_q^* (cyclic, standing in for GT) with a hard budget T=ceil(budget_factor*k0) total multiplications: trails walk, report DPs into a store, and a cross-trail DP collision solves the log. Report the fraction of trials finding a usable collision within T and the mean abandonments. One multiplication per step; no tortoise/hare. Toy-scale evidence for the random-mapping collision-time model only.
